name: com.pikosabe/piko
title: Piko
description: Search real local offers and providers, currently in Paraguay and Bolivia, and draft a listing.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Searches the Piko marketplace in one country, by meaning and by exact words. Returns at most 5 providers or 10 listings from real accounts, ordered by relevance, each with its pikosabe.com link. Listings that are job openings or job seekers' offers carry a job field with the working arrangement and the pay when stated. A count of 0 means no listing matches these terms. Results carry no phone number: contact happens on the pikosabe.com page of the listing or profile.

mode.description: providers: people who offer a service, grouped by profile. listings: individual published offers or demands of any type.

query.description: What is searched: a short phrase such as "plomero", "auto usado" or "Toyota Hilux". Listings are written in Spanish, so a Spanish phrase matches best.

side.description: Listings mode only. offer: things and services people offer. demand: things and services people are looking for. Omitted: both.

types.description: Listings mode only. Limits the search to these listing types.

city.description: Limits the search to this city, for example "Asunción".

neighborhood.description: Limits the search to this neighborhood of the city.

job_openings.description: true: only job openings, the positions an employer wants to fill (a nanny, a shop assistant). They are demand listings of type service; mode, side and types are set accordingly.

job_seekers.description: true: only job seekers, the providers who marked a service offer as available for a job, with the arrangement and the pay they expect when stated. They are offer listings of type service; mode, side and types are set accordingly. Not combined with job_openings.

country.description: Market to read: PY = Paraguay, BO = Bolivia, UY = Uruguay. Results stay within that market.

tools.name: show_listing
tools.description: Returns one active listing by its id: title, description, price, place, owner and its pikosabe.com link. Results carry no phone number: contact happens on the pikosabe.com page of the listing or profile.

listing_id.description: Listing id, as returned by search or show_profile.

country.description: Market to read: PY = Paraguay, BO = Bolivia, UY = Uruguay. Results stay within that market.

tools.name: show_profile
tools.description: Returns one public profile, found by user id or by name or @nickname: biography, place, rating, recent reviews, active offers and demands, and its pikosabe.com link. When several profiles match a name, returns the list of matches instead. Results carry no phone number: contact happens on the pikosabe.com page of the listing or profile.

user_id.description: User id, as returned by search.

query.description: Name or @nickname, for example "Teresa" or "@juanito". Used when no user_id is known.

country.description: Market to read: PY = Paraguay, BO = Bolivia, UY = Uruguay. Results stay within that market.

tools.name: prepare_listing
tools.description: Stores a draft of a listing for 24 hours and returns a pikosabe.com link to it. Nothing is published by this tool: the person opens the link, signs in to Piko with their phone, reviews the prefilled form and publishes it themselves. The draft is checked against the rules of the publishing form (title and description lengths, currency of the market, no phone number in the text). The listing is located at the place confirmed in the person's Piko profile, so the draft carries no city.

country.description: Market to read: PY = Paraguay, BO = Bolivia, UY = Uruguay. Results stay within that market.

side.description: offer: the person offers a service or has something to sell or rent out. demand: the person is looking for a service, a thing or someone to hire.

type.description: Listing type. rental is a thing rented out by the day or week; housing for sale or rent is property.

title.description: Listing title in Spanish, 10 to 60 characters, for example "Electricista matriculado a domicilio".

description.description: Details in Spanish, up to 1000 characters, in the person's own terms. Optional.

price_amount.description: Price for an offer, pay for a position, maximum budget for another demand. Omitted when the person gave no amount.

price_currency.description: Currency code of the amount. By market: PY PYG or USD, BO BOB or USD, UY UYU or USD. Omitted: the market's own currency.

transaction.description: Goods offered: sale, free or exchange. Property offered or wanted: sale or rental. Pets offered or wanted: sale or free (adoption). Other types have no transaction.

job.description: Present when the listing is a position an employer wants to fill (a nanny, a shop assistant). It goes with side demand and type service.

pay_period.description: Period the pay in price_amount is quoted for. Omitted: month.
